title: Book Two · Chapter 3: The Other Sleeve
story:
Mum has two small shirts on the table on Wednesday.

One shirt has a blue sleeve. The other has a green sleeve. Their owners will collect them before dinner.

Ronan puts his school bag by the wall.

“Can you help me for a minute?” Mum asks.

He comes to the table.

“Please put the green shirt in this bag. Leave the blue one here.”

Ronan reaches for the blue sleeve.

“The green shirt,” Mum says.

His hand stops.

“I heard you.”

“Then look at your hand.”

He looks. His fingers are on the blue cloth.

He lets go and picks up the other shirt. Mum holds the bag open. Ronan puts the green shirt inside.

“Why does the blue one stay?” he asks.

Mum turns the sleeve. A small white mark is near the cuff.

“I need to take this mark out. The sewing is done.”

Ronan can see the mark now. It is not very large.

“Will you tell the owner?”

“If it stays, yes. I will try this first.”

She folds a clean cloth and sets out a little bowl of water. Ronan steps back to keep his book dry.

“I did something like that at school,” he says.

“Put a shirt in a bag?”

“The wrong thing. In the wrong place.”

He tells her about the red card.

Mum works on the sleeve and listens. She asks him to bring a dry cloth. This time he looks at both cloths before he chooses one.

“Did you hurry?” she asks.

“I wanted to finish first.”

“And did you?”

“For a little while.”

Mum smiles. “Then there was more work.”

He looks at the two shirts. The green one is ready. The blue one needs time.

“Do you always read the little notes?”

“Sometimes I look too fast. Then I must look again. I can still make mistakes.”

She rubs the sleeve gently. The white mark grows smaller.

Ronan takes out his book. He puts it on his knees, away from the water. He reads the short page once. Then he goes back to the first line.

Mum does not ask him to read faster.

Outside, Mrs Lan drops a spoon. The cat runs from under her chair. Ronan looks up at the noise.

“It was only a spoon,” she tells the cat.

The cat stays by the gate. Mrs Lan picks up the spoon herself.

A woman comes for the green shirt. Mum takes it from the bag. The woman checks the new seam. Ronan moves his feet out of her way.

The woman bends her arm, then straightens it.

“That is better.”

She pays Mum and takes the shirt away.

Later, Mum lifts the blue sleeve to the window. The mark is gone. She hangs the shirt on a clean hook.

“Now both are ready,” Ronan says.

Mum puts the little bowl away.

Ronan reaches for his school note. He checks the red edge under the book in his drawing. He makes the pencil beside it a little clearer.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sleeve＝袖子；cuff＝袖口；seam＝缝合处；straighten＝伸直。

## 理解问题

1. Mum为什么暂时留下蓝袖子的衣服？
2. Ronan拿第二块布时和拿衣服时有什么不同？

## 读句子

His fingers / are on / the blue cloth.＝他的手指／放在／蓝色布料上。
